task: Fix issue #2929 by adding ADR-057 behavioral eval scenarios for /ship mode detection

events.content: Read issue #2929, ADR-057, /ship command spec, prompt eval methodology, existing scenario schemas, and eval runner contract. Added tests/evals/ship-scenarios.json with eight mode-detection scenarios covering ADO URL forms, GitHub URL, missing origin, contributor mode, closed or merged PR handling, and owner marker requirement.
